# Test R7: Auto and Check repr
print()
print('=== R7: Auto and Check repr ===')
print('Auto repr:', repr(Auto()))
print('Check() repr:', repr(Check()))
print('Check with spec:', repr(Check('spec')))
print('Check with type:', repr(Check(type=str)))
print('Check with equal_to:', repr(Check(equal_to='val')))

print('Check with instance_of:', repr(Check(instance_of=str)))
print('Check with default:', repr(Check(type=str, default='fallback')))
print('Check with validate:', repr(Check(validate=lambda x: x > 0)))
